content_sections.heading: SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Eligibility for this recruitment is reckoned as on 31.07.2026 . Any revisions or corrigendum will be hosted only on the Bank's official website, so candidates should check it regularly.

content_sections.heading: SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for the SIB Business Promotion Officer post is assessed as on 31.07.2026, based on the criteria below. Important eligibility note: Candidates who have already attended a Group Discussion/Personal Interview for the Junior Officer role under any previous SIB notification(s), and were not included in the final selection list, are not eligible to apply again for this SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 drive. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

rows.requirement: Maximum 30 years (born on or after 01.08.1996). 5 years' age relaxation for SC/ST candidates.
Minimum 2 years of experience in a Bank/NBFC in retail assets / liability products

content_sections.heading: SIB Junior Officer (BPO) Terms of Employment

rows.detail: Junior Officer / Business Promotion Officer (a target-based sales role)
On contract, initially for 3 years, renewable subject to performance evaluation and business requirements, at the Bank's discretion

On completion of the initial or extended contract period, high-performing candidates identified by the Bank may - without any obligation and at the Bank's sole discretion - be considered for regular employment as Assistant Manager (Scale I), subject to the Bank's then-prevailing norms

Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Ahmedabad regions (see state-wise breakup below); liable to be transferred anywhere in India at the Bank's sole discretion; proficiency in the local language will be given preference

content_sections.heading: SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Salary / CTC
content_sections.text: The total CTC at the time of joining is Rs. 7.85 lakhs per annum , structured as follows: Additionally, Junior Officers posted under the Delhi, Mumbai and Pune regions are eligible for a special allowance of Rs. 10,000/month , and those posted under the Ahmedabad region are eligible for a special allowance of Rs. 5,000/month , after 3 months of active service and subject to performance review. Official Duty allowance: Lodging allowance, halting allowance and travelling expense for official travel, as per Bank norms. Insurance coverage: Group Medical Insurance and Group Accident Insurance provided at the Bank's cost; Group Life Insurance is arranged with the premium borne by the employee. Other allowances, staff loans, perquisites, benefits and facilities applicable to the Bank's regular employees are not applicable to this contractual role. Increment: Annual increment during the contract period is released based on performance evaluation or other parameters decided by the Bank from time to time.

content_sections.heading: SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 - General Conditions
content_sections.text: Applicants must fulfil all eligibility criteria (age, qualification, experience) at the time of applying; if any information furnished is later found false, the selection/appointment is liable to be terminated. Upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years only for SC/ST candidates, who must submit attested certificates from a competent authority when called for. Applicants should retain two copies of the photograph used in the application, for use during the recruitment process. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Applicants must appear for the recruitment process at their own cost. Only applicants willing to serve anywhere in India should apply. Appointment is subject to medical fitness and satisfactory background verification, including credit history/CIBIL check and police clearance, along with completion of other formalities as per Bank rules. Shortlisting is provisional and without verification of original documents; candidature is subject to verification of all details/documents against originals at the time of interview/training/joining. Interview call letters/advices, where required, will be sent only by email - no hard copy will be sent. All revisions or corrigendum will be hosted only on the Bank's official website. By submitting the application, the applicant consents to the collection, processing, storage, use and disclosure of their personal information and documents for purposes connected with the recruitment process and related administrative, legal and regulatory requirements, as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 is South Indian Bank's recruitment drive for the post of Junior Officer / Business Promotion Officer (BPO), a target-based sales role, filled on a 3-year renewable contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 31 August 2026. It opened on 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in any stream, not more than 30 years old as on 31.07.2026 (born on or after 01.08.1996), with a minimum of 2 years' experience in a Bank/NBFC in retail assets or liability products. SC/ST candidates get 5 years' age relaxation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years as on 31.07.2026, with 5 years' relaxation for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for SIB Junior Officer (Business Promotion Officer)?
faq.answer: The total CTC at joining is Rs. 7.85 lakhs per annum (Fixed CTC of Rs. 4.49 lakhs including NPS, Variable Pay of Rs. 2.88 lakhs, and a Health Insurance premium of Rs. 0.48 lakhs paid by the Bank). Special regional allowances of Rs. 10,000/month (Delhi/Mumbai/Pune) or Rs. 5,000/month (Ahmedabad) apply after 3 months of active service, subject to performance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisting, followed by Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview, and a Psychometric Assessment. The Group Discussion is an elimination round.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only through the official South Indian Bank website, www.southindianbank.bank.in, between 19.08.2026 and 31.08.2026. No other mode of application is accepted.
